text: Lost a client to someone cheaper? It wasn't your price.
spoken: They just couldn't tell you apart from the others.
visual: POV, hands only, home-office desk at night: the phone fills the frame with one huge message bubble: "We can get it done cheaper from someone else." The thumb stops above the keyboard

text: Lost a client to someone cheaper? It wasn't your price.
spoken: Drop your price, and the next one still goes cheaper.
visual: POV, hands only: the phone fills the frame with one huge message bubble: "We can get it done cheaper from someone else." A pen in the other hand hovers over a printed price

text: "Drop your price." No. Stop sounding like everyone else.
spoken: They can get it done cheaper because you sound the same.
visual: Top-down desk: three identical white sheets side by side, same three headings, only the red price stickers differ; a hand picks the sheet with the smallest sticker

text: When you sound like everyone, price is all that's left.
spoken: That's why you hear: we can get it cheaper elsewhere.
visual: Top-down desk: three identical white sheets side by side, same three headings, only the red price stickers differ; a hand picks the sheet with the smallest sticker

text: Too expensive, or the same as everyone? Find out.
spoken: They went cheaper? Here's an easy way to find out if it's you.
visual: POV, hands only: a hand holds up one plain white sheet next to two identical sheets on the desk; only the price differs

text: One sentence decides if they go cheaper
spoken: I can tell who loses to cheaper from your first sentence.
visual: POV, hands only: a printed sheet, its first line circled hard in red pen; the rest of the page blurred

text: Never answer "cheaper" with a lower price
spoken: They can get it done cheaper? Don't touch your price.
visual: POV, hands only: the phone fills the frame with one huge bubble: "We can get it done cheaper from someone else." The other hand pulls a pen back from a price

text: Cheaper coach vs the coach they can't compare
spoken: You both got the same question. Only you dropped your price.
visual: Two phones side by side on one desk, each with the same bubble: "Why you, and not the others?"
